settings.title: Orders
settings.subtitle: Drop-offs, statuses and the “ready” message to the client

settings.noRights: Only the owner can turn this on or off

accept.title: You take in an item
accept.text: What was handed in, photos, due date and price. The order gets a link — send it to the client.

ready.title: You tap “Ready”
ready.text: The client gets a message with the link automatically: an app push or Telegram.

link.title: No more “is it ready?” calls
link.text: The link shows the status, what's left to pay, your address and phone — no sign-in.

remind.title: Not picked up? We remind
remind.text: After 3 and 7 days the client automatically gets “Your order is ready and waiting”. You can change the timing above.

estimate.title: Estimates — one tap
estimate.text: After diagnostics, send an estimate: the client taps “Approve” or “Decline” via the link. No reply in a day — we'll remind them.

dropoff.title: The client books a drop-off
dropoff.text: On your page they pick when they’ll bring the item and say what it is. You know who to expect — no queue at the counter.

reminders.title: If the client doesn’t pick up
reminders.description: We’ll remind the client the same way as “Ready”: push, Telegram or your SMS/WhatsApp. No messages at night (21:00–10:00).
reminders.label: When to remind
reminders.d3Hint: Once, on the third day after “Ready”
reminders.d3_7Hint: Twice — the fastest way to get orders picked up

intake.title: Drop-off booking
intake.description: Clients choose on your page when they’ll bring the item — the booking appears in the calendar. When they arrive, “Accept order” in one tap.
intake.toggleHint: A “Book a drop-off” button on your client page
intake.slotHint: The slot length in the calendar — to check the item and create the order
intake.staffHint: Slots follow their schedules; the client goes to whoever is free.
intake.noStaff: No one to accept: add a staff member

receipt.cancelled: Order cancelled — this receipt is no longer valid

declineConfirm.title: Client declined the repair?
